name: gopro-dashboard-overlay
role: Python CLI that renders telemetry gauges and maps as video from GoPro metadata or a GPX or FIT track
summary: Python CLI (`gopro-dashboard.py`) that draws speed, heart rate, altitude, charts, a moving map and a route trace from GoPro GPMF telemetry or a plain GPX or FIT file, using layouts written in XML. It pipes frames to FFmpeg; with `--use-gpx-only` it needs no video. Map widgets fetch online tiles.
use_when: A timed GPS track must become frame-synced gauges or a route trace; nothing catalogued does this
Telemetry from a GPX file, with no GoPro footage, should drive a dashboard overlay
Over d3 or canvas-2d when the data is a timestamped track and the layout is XML widgets
avoid_when: Static map images: maplibre-native or chiitiler
A globe or free-form data graphic: three-globe or d3
Gauges from arbitrary non-GPS data series: d3 or canvas-2d

install.macos: python3.12 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install gopro-overlay==0.134.0

notes: 2026-11-27: GPL-3.0-or-later per PyPI metadata and LICENSE.md; run as a separate process, never link. The README says the bundled icons are not covered by the project licence.

2026-11-27: lead said Python 3.10 or 3.11+; PyPI says >=3.11. The lead's default font Roboto is not on this machine, so the run used `--font Arial.ttf`. `--generate overlay` is rejected with `--use-gpx-only`; the default FFmpeg output (H.264) drops alpha, so transparency needs an ffmpeg profile in the config dir (the fixture uses qtrle/argb).
2026-11-27: speed derived from the first GPX points read 33 km/h at t=0 on a true 36 km/h track; map tiles are not exercised.

assessment.rationale: PyPI 0.134.0 published 2026-05-16; GPL-3.0-or-later (passes the free-software gate, process boundary kept). Nothing catalogued turns a timed GPS track into synced gauges: maplibre-native and chiitiler render static maps, three-globe a globe.

evidence.result: 8 of 10 checks pass: GPX-only 640x360 qtrle argb overlay, 303 frames, identical frame hashes over two renders, transparent corner, 100 distinct frames; digits read 120/130/140 hr, 100/110/120 m, speed 33/36/36. KNOWN FAIL: speed 33 at t=0 (36 expected); 100 distinct frames (101 expected).
evidence.scope: GPX-only text/bar widgets, transparent qtrle output; not GoPro/FIT input or maps; t=0 speed and distinct-frame checks failed; macOS arm64, Python 3.12.
